title: Replace with a short incident title
description: Replace with two or three sentences: who is affected, what they see, and what this practice scenario is testing.
scope: Out-of-hours VDI practice scenario. Replace this sentence with the real scope.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Replace: what a good answer looks like, and what must not be scored as demonstrated (unsafe production change, wrong owner, unofficial callout).
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: Replace with a valid investigation order.
Replace with another valid order if more than one path is acceptable.

documentationReferences.title: Replace with an illustrative runbook title
documentationReferences.note: Confirm locally against the approved document.

initialIncident.callSummary: Replace with the call you would get: time, who rang, symptoms, what already works, what does not, any change or vendor already named. Put every fact the engineer needs here. There are no extra evidence panels.

serviceNow.shortDescription: Replace with a short ticket title
serviceNow.description: Replace with the mock ticket body. Repeat the facts from the call summary if they belong on the record.

impact.colleagues: Replace with who else is on the call.
impact.business: Replace with the business impact. Mark it as illustrative if needed.

questions.prompt: What would you check first, and why?
questions.helpText: Cover what you would check, who you would involve, and what you would not change.
questions.assessorGuidance: Reward a scoped first check. Do not score an unsafe first action as demonstrated.

questions.prompt: What fault domains would you keep in play, and which would you set aside?
questions.assessorGuidance: Look for more than one relevant domain, and for setting aside something the story does not support.

questions.prompt: Who would you engage (Ops, TRM, another team, a vendor), and what would you not do in production?
questions.assessorGuidance: Reward using the support model. Unsafe production changes must not score as demonstrated.

questions.prompt: How would you confirm recovery and what would you say in a stakeholder update?
questions.assessorGuidance: Expect user confirmation plus a factual update. Closing from a green portal tile alone is not enough.

scoringCriteria.label: Establishes impact before changing the platform
Uses the support model instead of unofficial production changes
